x1_freeze_rule: No v642-v1 x2 builder, evidence outcome, or result claim may be created until this packet has a dedicated commit, is pushed, and local/upstream/tracking/live-remote equality is proved.

proposals.title: Counterevidence provenance and citation-context inheritance audit
proposals.mission_surface: provenance, semantic deduplication, source independence, counterevidence retention, and context integrity
proposals.hypothesis: A polarity-aware claim-evidence graph with authority-root partitions, context fingerprints, derivation edges, and merge or excerpt rules will preserve every inherited negative and caveat, collapse paraphrased duplicates, and reject citation-context laundering without treating document count as source independence.
proposals.null_or_failure: A negative or caveat disappears after merge, excerpt, or summary; paraphrased evidence is counted twice; two documents with one authority root are labeled independent; or a claim survives outside the scope supported by its citation context.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Index all 80 frozen proposals, mutate polarity, scope, authority-root aliases, excerpts, and merge order, and require zero erased negatives, zero unsupported scope expansion, and zero false-independent roots.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the transformed claim, restore its full context and negative edges, collapse the duplicate root, retain the failing vector, and lower the affected claim until replay passes.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: V2-v8 covered roots, lineage, support sets, retractions, quorums, expiry, and negative retention. V642-v1 uniquely tests whether counterevidence polarity and citation scope survive excerpting, paraphrase, merge order, and context transfer.

proposals.title: Variational boundary-condition and surface-term equivalence tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: canonical typed GMUT equations, units, covariance, conservation, stability, identifiability, and admissible boundary data
proposals.hypothesis: For the repository's typed scalar-tensor/EFT research scaffold, integration-by-parts-equivalent action forms will yield matching bulk equations only when declared surface terms and admissible initial or boundary conditions are tracked, while unit, free-index, covariance, conservation, stability, and identifiability violations remain rejecting failures.
proposals.null_or_failure: An omitted surface term changes the variational problem without detection; inadmissible boundary data passes; bulk forms disagree under declared equivalence; a unit, covariance, divergence, stability, or rank failure survives; or structural consistency is described as empirical confirmation.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Seed omitted, wrong-sign, non-cancelling, and dimensionally invalid surface terms plus inadmissible initial or boundary conditions; require exact rejection links and keep every empirical, unique-prediction, detected-force, and Theory-of-Everything flag false.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the canonical action register, mark the variational problem incomplete, retain the counterexample, narrow admissible conditions, and prohibit promotion beyond a structural research scaffold.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases tested traces, limits, units, scale changes, solvers, rank, assumptions, and mutation kills. This proposal adds well-posed variational boundary data and surface-term equivalence, which none of the 70 prior proposals made the primary falsification target.

proposals.title: Selection-function covariance and nuisance-lock adapter contract
proposals.mission_surface: public-data empirical-adapter and baseline readiness without likelihood or fit inflation
proposals.hypothesis: A zero-row metadata adapter can bind selection function, mask or window semantics, covariance shape, nuisance parameters, baseline choice, release identity, citation, and transformation order, rejecting incompatible fixtures while emitting no likelihood, parameter estimate, or empirical GMUT claim.
proposals.null_or_failure: Selection or window semantics are omitted; covariance dimensions or ordering drift; nuisance or baseline choices change after exposure; release metadata crosses products; real rows or inference outputs appear; or readiness is called a fit.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run official-metadata-derived zero-row fixtures through selection, mask, covariance, nuisance, baseline, release, citation, and order mutations; require quarantine and exact zero measurement rows, likelihood calls, and fitted parameters.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Disable the adapter, retain the rejected fixture, restore the pinned metadata contract, and require a separately authorized preregistration before any data download or inference.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: V2-v8 covered adapter shape, no-download readiness, inference barriers, release leakage, integrity, licence, and schema drift. This proposal targets the observational selection, window, covariance, nuisance, and baseline semantics that must precede a defensible likelihood.

proposals.title: Sequence-balanced THOS crossover and carryover quarantine
proposals.mission_surface: preregistered blind matched-budget THOS arms with period, sequence, carryover, and exposure controls
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic-only crossover protocol can lock sequence allocation, period effects, washout assumptions, learning, fatigue, evaluator blinding, matched token-time-tool exposure, exclusions, and analysis order before unsealing, rejecting any fixture that conditions these choices on synthetic outcomes.
proposals.null_or_failure: Arm order is unbalanced; period or carryover is ignored; washout is asserted without evidence; evaluator state leaks; budget exposure differs; exclusions depend on outcomes; or proxy rehearsal is called real superiority, AGI, ASI, consciousness, or personhood evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise deterministic synthetic sequences with order, washout, period, learning, fatigue, evaluator, exposure, exclusion, and unsealing mutations; reject every biased fixture before scores are exposed and record zero real-arm runs.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Invalidate the affected rehearsal, preserve its mutation, reseal a clean synthetic sequence, and keep all real-performance, AGI/ASI, consciousness, and personhood claims prohibited.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior THOS proposals covered matched budgets, missingness, power, contamination, rubrics, exchangeability, estimands, attrition, and stopping. This proposal uniquely centers within-unit sequence, period, washout, learning, fatigue, and carryover threats.

proposals.title: Selective-disclosure correlation and unlinkability boundary
proposals.mission_surface: Freed ID structural and standards conformance with disclosure, privacy, status, resolution, interoperability, cryptography, and trust-governance boundaries
proposals.hypothesis: A structural fixture suite can detect over-disclosure, stable correlators, mandatory-reveal leakage, status-list correlation, resolver freshness faults, holder-binding gaps, draft-as-stable substitution, and absent trust governance while never claiming real unlinkability or cryptographic assurance.
proposals.null_or_failure: A correlating field or proof option passes without warning; disclosure exceeds the declared purpose; stale status or resolution is accepted; a draft pin replaces a stable requirement; or synthetic structure is called cryptographically unlinkable, interoperable, deployed, or governed.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Use inert synthetic records to mutate revealed fields, persistent identifiers, mandatory pointers, status grouping, resolver freshness, holder binding, version pins, interoperability evidence, and governance; require fail-closed structural results and production assurance false.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the fixture, minimize disclosure, rotate the synthetic correlator, restore stable pins, retain the failure, and leave real keys, proofs, services, interoperability review, and governance open.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier Freed ID work covered profiles, lifecycle, status, resolution, cryptographic bundles, state machines, and assurance composition. This proposal makes selective-disclosure correlation and unlinkability leakage the primary boundary, using the BBS draft only as a visible work-in-progress source.

proposals.title: Standing remedy-preservation and anti-retaliation authority gate
proposals.mission_surface: CBR conflict analysis, standing, affected-party legitimacy, remedy preservation, legal limits, and Māori authority
proposals.hypothesis: A non-authoritative conflict protocol can record claimed standing or representation, evidence preservation, interim safeguards, remedy non-waiver, retaliation risk, recusal, dissent, rights floors, competent legal referral, affected-party authority, and Māori authority while refusing to decide for them.
proposals.null_or_failure: The system decides standing, speaks for Māori, treats consultation as consent, waives a remedy, suppresses dissent, exposes a complainant, provides legal judgment, claims cultural ratification or enacted-law status, or resolves a conflict without authorized affected parties and competent authorities.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run synthetic standing, representation, evidence-loss, remedy-waiver, retaliation, recusal, rights-floor, legal-competence, and Māori-authority conflicts; require exact_gate whenever an authorized human or authority is absent.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Withdraw any substituted decision, stop exposure, preserve evidence and dissent, reinstate the remedy and recusal route, and refer only to authorized affected parties, Māori authority, or competent legal authority.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior CBR work covered consent, vetoes, empty chairs, rights floors, contestability, remedies, withdrawal, and non-substitution. This proposal adds standing and representation uncertainty, evidence and remedy preservation, non-waiver, and anti-retaliation safeguards as explicit refusal conditions.

proposals.title: Parser-depth decompression and resource-ceiling denial battery
proposals.mission_surface: bounded threat modelling, negative tests, privacy controls, availability limits, and non-destructive recovery
proposals.hypothesis: A bounded artifact pipeline can reject metadata-only fixtures for excessive expansion ratios, nesting depth, object or key counts, duplicate keys, oversized tokens, recursion, and time or memory budgets before unsafe work occurs, without creating large payloads or claiming exhaustive security.
proposals.null_or_failure: A resource-ceiling vector passes; limits apply after expansion; duplicate keys alter meaning silently; recovery destroys evidence or expands privilege; a privacy or raw-ID hit is ignored; or bounded availability tests are called exhaustive security.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Evaluate only inert size and shape metadata for expansion, nesting, count, duplicate-key, token, recursion, and budget vectors; require pre-consumption rejection, no large materialization, no privilege change, preserved evidence, and zero raw-ID hits.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop parsing, quarantine metadata, retain the vector, restore the clean owned snapshot, tighten the smallest relevant ceiling, and rerun without elevation or destructive cleanup.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier security work covered prompt injection, archives, collisions, encodings, provenance poisoning, TOCTOU, links, privacy, and recovery. This proposal targets pre-consumption resource ceilings and availability denial without materializing dangerous payloads.

proposals.title: Stdlib verifier ablation and dual-oracle replay
proposals.mission_surface: clean-snapshot and cross-owner repeatability with reduced tool common mode and an explicit independent-team gap
proposals.hypothesis: A path-relative Python-standard-library verifier derived from a machine-readable specification can independently recompute the phase's core counts, gate decisions, and commitments under declared dependency ablations and agree with the family validator in fresh detached snapshots, while remaining same-owner evidence.
proposals.null_or_failure: The minimal verifier requires private routes, absolute machine paths, network, untracked inputs, optional packages, or owner-specific state; its oracle diverges; ablated dependencies are hidden; or local agreement is called independent-team reproduction.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run the family validator and stdlib-only oracle in clean detached D-drive snapshots, compare decision and count outputs, reject undeclared dependencies, and keep independent_team_reproduction false absent a genuinely independent team.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain any divergence, identify the shared or hidden dependency, invalidate parity, rebuild from the sealed source, and lower the claim to the exact same-owner or chain-internal repeatability observed.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: V2-v8 created manifests, perturbation snapshots, cross-owner history, common-mode budgets, and an external-executor contract. V642-v1 adds an actually executable stdlib-only second oracle plus dependency-ablation tests, while preserving the independent-team gap.

proposals.title: Thermo-psyche construct-validity and causal-direction barrier
proposals.mission_surface: explicit thermo-psyche classification, construct validity, causal direction, alternatives, and category barriers
proposals.hypothesis: Every thermo-psyche statement can be forced to declare its class, construct, operationalization, causal direction, counterfactual or intervention requirement, alternative explanations, authority needs, and falsifier, preventing notation, correlation, metaphor, or normative preference from becoming a physical or consciousness law.
proposals.null_or_failure: A class lacks a construct or falsifier; correlation becomes causation; a metric becomes the construct by definition; alternatives disappear; a normative statement becomes physical by notation; or a fundamental thermo-psyche law or consciousness tensor is declared established.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate construct labels, operationalizations, causal arrows, intervention burdens, alternative explanations, normative authority, and falsifiers across all six classes; reject every category shortcut and keep law and consciousness counts zero.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Return the statement to its last justified class, restore alternatives and missing burdens, retain the failed vector, remove causal, law, consciousness, or personhood wording, and require the missing domain evidence.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: V6-v8 classified, relabeled, and governed promotions. V642-v1 adds construct validity, operationalization, causal direction, intervention burden, and alternative explanations rather than another class-transition machine.

proposals.title: Stage 20 evidence-order regret and authority-preserving queue
proposals.mission_surface: terminal Stage 20 pass/fail/defer board, evidence-order discipline, and non-substitutable authority
proposals.hypothesis: A bounded evidence-acquisition queue can rank only safe technical work by expected uncertainty reduction, reversibility, dependency unlock, and failure cost while treating affected-party, Māori, legal, cultural, identity, proof, deployment, security, and independent-review gates as non-substitutable and never converting a fail or defer into pass.
proposals.null_or_failure: A score closes an exact gate; authority or consent is optimized away; a negative is dropped; unsafe or irreversible work outranks safe work; a fail or defer becomes pass without evidence; or Stage 20 is marked ready while any mandatory gate remains unresolved.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate evidence value, reversibility, dependency, failure cost, authority type, and board decision; require exact gates to remain non-ranked or deferred, inherited negatives to remain present, and the terminal verdict to stay NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the monotonic board, remove any authority-substitution score, reinsert negatives, downgrade unsupported passes, and leave Stage 20 closed until every mandatory gate has exact evidence.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior boards covered contradictions, expiry, monotonicity, compression, sunsets, falsifier links, cut-sets, and stop rules. This proposal adds safe evidence-order regret and value-of-information logic while making non-substitutable authority impossible to score away.

non_claims: Expected dispositions are preregistered forecasts, not x2 results.

No proposal establishes empirical GMUT, a detected force, a unique prediction, a Theory of Everything, real THOS superiority, AGI/ASI, consciousness, personhood, real Freed ID cryptography, enacted law, cultural ratification, Māori authority, deployment, exhaustive security, complete accessibility conformance, or independent-team reproduction.
Māori concepts, language, data, and governance remain under Māori authority.
